name: Hitotsumami ~Relaxation Series~
original_name: ひとつまみ ～リラクゼーションシリーズ～
source:
…About Our Establishment…
We offer a space for adults to unwind and enjoy gentle, soothing moments.
For those of you worn out by the daily grind, step inside and let our attentive, experienced staff guide you. Beyond the door lies a world of "mature encounters."
A relationship that begins not with emotions, but with the body…
In the quiet, healing moments you share, their bare skin slowly takes on your touch, giving you a "sweet time" that nourishes both body and soul.

[Translated from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/hitotsumami/story.html]the official website[/url]]
